messages:
jon_support: 🚨 Quick escalation — AstraMed can't finish onboarding seat activation after token rotation. Case #4521. Renewal in 18 days. Need CS takeover.

sasha_csm: Thanks. Do we have a minimal repro + logs? Can we pause rotation for that tenant?

jon_support: Repro + log below:
```
ERROR 401: auth token invalid for tenant astra-432
stack: auth/kms: decrypt failed: invalid key version
request-id: req_0a1b2c3d
```
We temporarily rolled back the rotation for that tenant; activation succeeded for a subset but some users still fail.

maria_cs: Are they on Dedicated or Private?

raj_se: They're Dedicated (eu-west-1), running SDK v1.2.3. Root cause: our KMS key cache didn't refresh after rotation; servers used old key version. Fix ready (hotpatch) but need CS to coordinate with customer for a short maintenance window.

sasha_csm: Ok — I'll propose a maintenance window today 16:00-16:30 UTC. Drafting comms: apology, what caused it, mitigation, next steps, credit offer. Renewal team should be looped — the account rep is @ben_sales.

jon_support: Customer is anxious; they mentioned "activation delay threatens go-live". They asked for priority onboarding support and a temporary credit.

sasha_csm: Proposed comms:
- short explainer + apology
- immediate mitigation performed (rollback + hotpatch scheduled)
- offer: one month onboarding credit + 2 weeks priority support
- timeline and contact: sasha_csm + raj_se
I'll post to them after sync with engineering.

deploy-bot: rollback completed at 2025-05-03T14:10:23Z. Hotpatch build v1.2.4 queued.

raj_se: Hotpatch applied to astra-432 at 2025-05-03T14:25Z. Monitoring metrics show token error rate down to 0.6% (from 12%). Still watching cache TTLs.

sasha_csm: Action items:
- sasha_csm: send customer comms + cc ben_sales (in next 30m)
- raj_se: run full tenant validation & share logs (by EOD)
- jon_support: update case notes and flag any returning failures
- maria_cs: prepare renewal team note w/ mitigation + credit offer

jon_support: Thanks team, marking support -> CS handoff complete. Will update case once comms sent.

sasha_csm: :thumbsup: I'll ping here when sent.
